√śvañc 'spread'
present: [1.] śváñcate etc. śmañc- 
aorist: śaśvacaí 
secondary: causative: śvañcáyas 
derivatives: -śvaṅka

√śvas 'blow'
present: [2.] śvasiti etc. V.+ śvasihí AV.+ aśvasīt B.+ aśvasat śuṣántam -- [1.] śvásati śvásate etc. AV.+ 
perfect: śaśvāsa E.+ 
aorist: [3.] aśiśvasat -- [5.] śvasīs 
future: [1.] śvasiṣyati -- [2.] śvasitā 
verbal: śvasita B.+ śvasta E.+ śvasitum -śvasya S.+ -śvásas intensive: śā́śvasat -- desiderative: śiśvasiṣa- -- causative: śvāsayati etc. V.+ śvasayati 
derivatives: -śvasa śvāsa V.+ śvāsin B.+ -śvāsya E.+ śuṣá V.B.S. śóṣa? VS. śvasaná V.+ -śvasanīya C. -śvāsana E.+ -śvāsanīya C. śvási- RV. -śvasitavya B.+ śvasátha V.B. śúṣma V.B. śuṣman C.

√svaj 'embrace'
present: [1.] svájate etc. V.+ svájati etc. svajāna 
perfect: sasvajé etc. V.+ sasvajus asvañje 
aorist: [3.] ásasvajat -- [4.] asvañkṣi 
future: [1.] svajiṣyate svaṅkṣyate -- [2.] svaṅktā 
verbal: svakta B.+ svaktum svajitvā -svajya E.+ -sváje 
[secondary: svajya- sāsvañj- sāsvajya- sisvaṅkṣa- svañjaya- ]
derivatives: svajá -svajya E. -svaṅga E.+ -svaṅgin C. -svajana C. -svajīyas AV. -svañjalya AV.

√svad 'sweeten'
present: [1.] svádati svádate etc. V.+ svādate 
perfect: sasvade sasvāde 
aorist: [3.] asiṣvadat etc. 
[future: svadiṣyate svādiṣyate svaditā svāditā ]
verbal: svāttá -súde -svādam 
secondary: intensive: sāsvad sāsvād- -- desiderative: sisvadiṣa sisvādiṣa- -- causative: svadáyati svadáyate etc. svādayati etc. E.+ svādyate 
derivatives: svada-? svāda C. -svādaka C. svādin C. -svādya E.+ svā́dana RV.C. svādanīya E. -svādas RV. svādú V.+ svā́dīyas V.+ svā́diṣṭha V.+ svā́dman RV. svādmán RV. svādiman C. svadayitṛ́ B. 
Compare √sūd, which is perhaps related.

√svan 'sound'
present: [1.] svanati svanate etc. -- asvanīt 
perfect: sasvāna sasvanus E.+ svenus 
aorist: [1.] sváni? -- [3.] asisvanat -- [5.] svānīt 
[future: svaniṣyati svanitā ]
verbal: svanita 
secondary: intensive: saniṣvanat saṅsvan- -- desiderative: sisvaniṣa- -- causative: svanayati etc. 
derivatives: -svan svaná V.+ svāná V.+ svānín RV. -svanas RV. sváni RV. svanáya RV.

√svap 'sleep'
present: [2.] svapiti svapanti etc. V.+ svapihi sváptu svapīta -- [1.] svápati etc. V.+ svápate etc. E.+ 
perfect: suṣvā[a suṣupus etc. V.+ suṣupāṇá suṣupthās 
aorist: [1.] supyāt asvāpi -- [3.] siṣvapas síṣvap asūṣupat -- [4.] asvāpsam etc. S.+ 
future: [1.] svapsyati etc. B.+ svapsyate etc. E.+ svapiṣyati svapiṣyate -- [2.] svaptā 
verbal: suptá AV.+ svaptum B.+ suptvā́ AV.+ -svā́pam 
secondary: passive: supyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: sāsvap- soṣup- -- desiderative: suṣupsa- -- causative: svāpáyati etc. V.+ svapayati 
derivatives: -sup svāpa E.+ -svāpin C. svapaná B.C. svāpana S.+ supti C. svaptavya B.+ svapitṛ C. svápna V.+ suṣupsā E. suṣupsu B.+

√svar 'sound'
present: [1.] svárati etc. 
perfect: sasvāra sasvarus sasvár? 
aorist: [3.] asisvarat -- [4.] ásvār asvārṣṭām -- [5.] asvārīs 
[future: svariṣyati svartā svaritā ]
verbal: svaritos -svāram 
secondary: intensive: sāsvar- -- desiderative: sisvariṣa- susvūrṣa- -- causative: svaryate svārayati 
derivatives: -svar svára AV.B. svará V.+ svaryà RV. svārá V.+ -svārya C. sváraṇa RV. -svaras RV. svarí? RV. sváru? V.B.S. sváritṛ RV. -svartṛ RV. svarīyas C. svarayitavya C. 
Hardly to be separated from this root are the derivatives showing the radical sense of 'brightness': namely,svàr V.+ -svara U.C. sū́ra V.B. sūrí? V.+ sū́rya V.+ sū́rta? V.
